function: Channel (SNR) forecast by sparse Gaussian process for task-offloading scheduling; excluded as system: scalar-SNR single-antenna link without RIS (p. 4, p. 10).
notes: Reason system. PDF title (p. 1) is 'Adaptive Task Offloading for Mobile Edge Computing With Forecast Information' and the DOI printed on p. 1 matches. The only learned element is the SGP-LMC channel forecast, 'we invoke a light-weight learning technique, i.e., GP, for channel forecast' (p. 8), which is area 2 prediction; the offloading decision itself is Lyapunov optimization, not learned (pp. 5-6), so no_learning and above_phy were not chosen. The link has no antenna array and no RIS: the rate is r_i(t) = B log2(1 + p_i(t) g_i(t)) with a scalar SNR g_i(t) from device i to the MEC server (p. 4), simulated with independent scalar Rayleigh fading and distance-dependent path loss (p. 10). IRS and mmWave beamforming appear only as other works in the related work (p. 2). The paper never states the antenna count in words, so the reviewer should confirm the single-antenna reading from p. 4 and p. 10. If the reviewer reads the forecast as serving task offloading, above_phy would apply instead; the work is excluded either way. Quantitative simulation results exist (Figs. 3-6, pp. 10-11), so results is not the reason.
